# QR code generator

`qrcode.js` is the unmodified JavaScript distribution from
[qrcode-generator 2.0.4](https://www.npmjs.com/package/qrcode-generator), by Kazuhiko Arase.
The npm tarball was checked against its published SHA-512 integrity value before extraction:

```text
sha512-mZSiP6RnbHl4xL2Ap5HfkjLnmxfKcPWpWe/c+5XxCuetEenqmNFf1FH/ftXPCtFG5/TDobjsjz6sSNL0Sr8Z9g==
```

Upstream: https://github.com/kazuhikoarase/qrcode-generator

License: MIT; see `qrcode-LICENSE` and the copyright notice in `qrcode.js`.
Only newline encoding may differ from the npm archive. No QR code service or CDN is contacted.
